hooks.name: milestone-verification
hooks.description: After each agent turn, run the fast CPU pytest suite (integration tests excluded; no GPU, long rollouts or network). Always exits 0 so a test failure is reported, not turned into another agent turn. Writes no files and makes no commits.

action.command: uv run --frozen --offline pytest -q -m 'not integration' -p no:cacheprovider; echo "milestone-verification: pytest exit code $?"; exit 0
